items.title: Paul Smith interviewed by Monk Rowe, Los Angeles, California, February 14, 1999
items.q: I played everybody from Dorothy Kirsten, Lawrence Melchior, Dinah Shore, Ella, and then all the other shows out there, Gisele MacKenzie, Gordon MacRae, Tony Martin

ctx.x: Did you have to become involved in the manipulation of the electronic instruments? Learning to program and all that kind of stuff?

No, that’s the reason I got out of it. I really didn’t want to become an electrician and I didn’t want to become a sound effects man. In fact one of the first time I played in one of the movies, I’ve forgotten which one, the conductor said, “you’ve got four bars of wind?” And I thought wait a minute, you know, what is this [scats]. You’re a sound effects man. And I still like to play music, and I still love piano, so I thought well this is a good time to just kind of back out of that, just play piano and play…
Now not all piano players make good accompanists.
